en.abdullah-al-shahin: (4) Muhammad bin Ya’qoob narrated from Ali bin Ibraheem from Salih as-Sindi from Ja’far bin Basheer that Issma’eel bin Muhammad al-Khuza’iy had said:

“Once I heard Abu Baseer asking Abu Abdullah as-Sadiq (as): “Do you think that I live until al-Qa’im appears?” Abu Abdullah as-Sadiq (as) said to him: “O Abu Baseer, Do you not know your imam?” Abu Baseer said: “I know him. By Allah, it is you.” Abu Abdullah (as) took Abu Baseer’s hand and said: “O Abu Baseer, by Allah, never mind if you are not under the shadow of al-Qa’im’s tent with your sword!”
